reviews.text: I really enjoyed this glitter eyeshadow. It has excellent staying power and creates a beautiful sparkling effect on the eyelids. One of my favorite features is the applicator, which makes application quick and easy without getting glitter all over my fingers. Anyone who has used loose glitter knows how difficult it can be to remove from your hands, so this is a huge advantage. Overall, it’s a fun and convenient product that delivers a gorgeous finish.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款閃粉眼影。持久力好好，喺眼皮上會有好靚嘅閃亮效果。我最鍾意嘅功能之一係塗抹器，令上妝快速又容易，唔會弄得手指都係閃粉。用過散裝閃粉嘅人都知道，要喺手上除走佢有幾難，所以呢點係一個好大嘅優點。整體嚟講，呢款產品好好玩、好方便，效果好靚。

reviews.text: Esperaba mucho este tiempo de sombras , aunque debo admitir que el aplicador es un poco incómodo y por lo menos a mi que tengo la piel sensible no fue fácil de aplicarlo , asique tuve que hacerlo con una brocha fina. El producto en cuanto al brillo es muy lindo , aunque se seca un poco y si lo llevas muchas horas puede llegar ha ser un poco irritable y molesto.
reviews.zh: 我好期待呢款眼影，不過我要承認，塗抹器有少少唔舒服，至少對我呢個敏感皮膚嚟講，用落唔係好容易，所以我唯有用幼刷子去搽。產品嘅閃亮效果好靚，不過會乾咗少少，如果戴好耐，可能會有少少刺激同令人唔舒服。

reviews.text: This cute little shiny ✨ gems are the perfect product to bring the shine! i feel like they are really versatile and multipurpose since you can use them as liquid eyeshadow and as a highlighter to use to enhance your features like the inner corner of your eyes and the highest parts of your cheekbones, I got shades 1 and 3 . shade number 1 is a silvery cool white with an almost pearlescent pink with some bigger glitters here and there, this is such a pretty color, it kinda reminds me of the benefit highlighter a little bit. the applicator is a silicone like tiny spatula which I like because I feel like it’s not as wasteful as with the furry applicators. shade number 3 is a warmer pink, with peach undertones and silver sparkles, very pretty too and might be suitable for neutral and warmer tones but since it has silver sparkles I think it could also be good for cool tones, both are sheer and buildable and the formula feels very soft and easy to use and apply but once they dry there are there to stay, since they are a creamy formula there’s no fallouts. very pretty and I am so happy with both shades but my favorite one is number 1 hands down . only down side is that they are really small and tiny but other than that hey are great!
reviews.zh: 呢啲可愛嘅閃亮小寶石 ✨ 係為你帶嚟閃光嘅最佳產品！我覺得佢哋好多用途，因為你可以當液態眼影，亦可以當提亮產品，用嚟突出五官，例如眼角內側同埋顴骨最高嘅位置。我買咗 1 號同 3 號。1 號係銀白色調嘅冷白，帶近乎珠光嘅粉紅，有啲大粒閃粉散佈其中，好靚嘅色，有啲令我聯想到 Benefit 提亮粉。塗抹器係似矽膠嘅細小刮刀，我好鍾意，因為感覺冇咁浪費，唔似毛絨嘅塗抹器咁。3 號係較暖嘅粉紅，帶桃色底調同銀色閃粉，都好靚，可能適合中性同暖色調，不過因為有銀色閃粉，我覺得都可以用喺冷色調膚色上。兩款都係通透但可以疊色，質地好軟、好易用同好易推開，但係乾咗之後就會牢牢咁留低；因為係膏狀質地，所以冇掉粉。兩款我都好滿意，但我最鍾意嘅係 1 號，毫無疑問。唯一缺點係佢哋真係好細粒，但除咗呢點之外，佢哋都好好！

reviews.text:
Llevaba tiempo queriendo probar los glitters de Unleashia y no me han decepcionado. Compré el tono moonlight liquid glitter y es precioso. Si buscas ese look tipo K-pop o estilo Euphoria, necesitas este glitter en tu vida. Las partículas holográficas brillan muchísimo, sobre todo con el flash de la cámara. El envase es muy estético y el producto rinde mucho porque con muy poca cantidad cubres bastante. 
Lo uso no solo en los ojos, sino también un poco en los pómulos para festivales. ¡El envío fue rápido y llegó en perfectas condiciones!
reviews.zh:
我一直好想試吓 Unleashia 嘅閃粉，而佢哋冇令我失望。我買咗 moonlight liquid glitter 嗰個色，好靚。如果你想要 K-pop 或者 Euphoria 嗰種造型，你一定要有呢款閃粉。全息閃粉非常閃亮，特別係用相機閃光燈嗰陣。外包裝好靚，而且好慳，因為只需要好少量就可以覆蓋到好多位置。
我唔單止用喺眼睛，仲會喺顴骨少少位置用，去節日派對。寄送好快，而且完好無缺咁收到！

reviews.text: Saw this one on Tiktok and was IMMEDIATELY influenced to get it! Its very true to color and I love that it was this wet feeling but dries down and doesnt smudge at all.. You can make it more natural or build it up, but it honestly is very prettyy.. Will definitely repurchase if it ever runs out plus I am thinking if getting the other two colors
reviews.zh: 喺 TikTok 見到呢款，即刻被影響咗，一定要買！顏色好正，我鍾意佢啲質感好似濕濕嘅，但乾咗之後就一啲都唔會暈開。可以化得自然啲，或者疊深啲，但係真係好靚……用完一定會再買，而且我都諗緊會唔會買另外兩個色。

reviews.text: I need to test it more to see how long it lasts on the eyes, but the sparkle is absolutely stunning! The glitter catches the light beautifully and gives my eyelids a soft, peachy shimmer. It applies smoothly and looks gorgeous for both everyday and special looks. So far, I’m really impressed with its glow and sparkle.
reviews.zh: 我仲要再多試吓，睇吓喺眼上可以維持幾耐，不過閃光效果真係好靚！閃粉照到光好漂亮，為我嘅眼皮添上一層柔和嘅桃色閃光。搽落好順滑，日常同特別場合都好靚。到目前為止，我真係好欣賞佢嘅光澤同閃亮效果。

reviews.text: "Me encanta este delineador con glitter para ojos! 💃🏻✨ Es perfecto para agregar un toque de brillo y glamour a mi maquillaje. La fórmula es suave y fácil de aplicar, y el glitter se mantiene en su lugar sin desvanecerse ni mancharse. 💅‍♀️👀 Me gusta que viene en una variedad de colores y tamaños de glitter para adaptarse a mi estilo. Sin duda, ¡es un producto que me hace sentir como una estrella de rock! 🤩"
reviews.zh: 「我好鍾意呢款閃粉眼線！💃🏻✨ 佢好適合為我嘅化妝加少少閃亮同華麗感。質地柔滑、易用，閃粉留喺位置上，唔會褪色或者暈花。💅‍♀️👀 我鍾意佢有多款顏色同閃粉大小，可以配合我嘅風格。無疑問，呢款產品令我感覺好似搖滾明星！🤩」

reviews.text:
Magnifique, j'ai la teinte 2 gold star et c'est un doré mais plutôt froid ! 
je voulais ce style de gel pour faire un trait dans le coin de l'œil ou dessous et franchement incroyable !
l'applicateur est en silicone/plastique mais plat, pas en pointe comme un liner 
le packaging est très joli et petit donc parfait à ranger.
reviews.zh:
好靚！我揀咗 2 號 gold star，係金色但偏冷色調！
我想要呢種啫喱，喺眼角或者眼下畫一條線，真係非常出色！
塗抹器係矽膠／膠質，但係扁身，唔似眼線筆咁係尖嘅。
包裝好靚又細細件，所以好易收埋。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
